rapport_notes: Exceptional — handled a sensitive downsizing situation (50 years in the home, widow) with real patience and care, and solved a tech-literacy barrier to get the same-day walkthrough scheduled.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'I just wanna ask if you have any important instructions or concerns about this move that you also want to discuss over the phone' — asked at the very start, before any logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer shared she'd lived in the home 50 years and was downsizing after her husband's passing; rep engaged with sustained, sensitive follow-up questions across the call about what was and wasn't coming.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'once we go over the minimum, we only charge in fifteen minute increments' / pricing explicitly framed as contingent on the upcoming walkthrough.

top_strength: Handled a sensitive, emotionally loaded moving situation (50-year home, recent loss, downsizing) with genuine patience, and proactively solved a tech barrier to get the walkthrough scheduled same-day.
coaching_note: The quid-pro-quo opening was vague ('ask questions so we can get you set up') — naming the specific payoff ('...so we can build you an accurate quote') would sharpen the framing.
